title: MegaDerm & MegaFill
caption: MegaDerm stock at HIGHST: 3–5 mm / 5 × 6, 5 × 8, 5 × 10, 6 × 12 cm
note: MegaDerm 시트형 동종진피와 MegaFill. 하이스트 보유 진피 규격: 두께 3–5 mm, 크기 5 × 6, 5 × 8, 5 × 10, 6 × 12 cm. 사진: 6 × 12 cm 진피와 MegaFill 주사기.
speakerNote: MegaDerm is a sheet acellular dermal matrix. HIGHST stocks hydrated and freeze-dried types. The stated thickness and sizes describe HIGHST's inventory. MegaFill is a micronized form of acellular dermal matrix. Photographs: 6 × 12 cm dermal graft and MegaFill syringes.

title: Preoperative Evaluation

rows.head: Blood tests
rows.body:
Blood coagulation tests (PT/PTT)
TTT (testosterone)
Complete blood count (CBC)
Prostate-specific antigen (PSA)
Blood glucose (BST/HbA1c)

rows.head: Screening and other tests
rows.body:
HIV testing
Syphilis testing
Urine testing
Liver enzymes (GOT/GPT/GGT)
Inflammatory markers

rows.head: Penile biothesiometry
rows.body:
Vibration perception threshold
Penile sensitivity assessment

note: 수술 전 평가: IIEF/PEDT 설문, 혈액·감염 검사, 신체진찰, 이완·신장 상태의 음경 길이 측정, 진동각 검사.
speakerNote:
Preoperative assessment at HIGHST includes IIEF and PEDT questionnaires, flaccid and stretched penile length measurement, and penile biothesiometry.

speakerNote: In our clinical experience at HIGHST, curvature or tilting and shortening may occur immediately after surgery. These early changes usually resolve as the graft softens.
